mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROJECT A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.PROJ_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.PROJ_ID AS projId , A.PROJ_NM AS projNm , A.PROJ_TYPE AS projType , A.STATUS AS status , A.START_DT AS startDt , A.END_DT AS endDt , A.COMPLEXITY_SCORE AS complexityScore , A.REQ_SKILLS AS reqSkills , B.CONT_NM AS contNm , B.CONT_AMT AS contAmt , C.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , D.CUST_NM AS custNm , E.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , F.EMP_NM AS mainMgrNm , G.EMP_NM AS salesUserNm , H.EMP_NM AS subMgrNm FROM TB_PROJECT A LEFT JOIN TB_CONTRACT B ON A.CONT_ID = B.CONT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SALES C ON B.SALES_ID = C.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER D ON C.CUST_ID = D.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP E ON B.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP F ON A.M_EMP_ID = F.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP G ON C.EMP_ID = G.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP H ON A.S_EMP_ID = H.EMP_ID WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ASSIGNMENT ( PROJ_ID, EMP_ID, ASSIGN_TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, INPUT_RATE, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{assignTitle}, STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{inputRate}, #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId , A.PROJ_ID AS projectId , A.EMP_ID AS userId , B.EMP_NM AS userNm , B.DEPT_NM AS deptNm , B.POSITION_NM AS positionNm , A.ASSIGN_TITLE AS assignTitle , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate , A.INPUT_RATE AS inputRate FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT A INNER JOIN TB_EMP B ON A.EMP_ID = B.EMP_ID WHERE A.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.IN_OFFICE = 'Y' ORDER BY A.ASSIGN_ID DESC

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(daily_rate), 0) FROM ( SELECT SUM(INPUT_RATE) as daily_rate FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT WHERE EMP_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT (END_DT < #{startDate} OR START_DT > #{endDate}) GROUP BY EMP_ID ) AS temp

SELECT A.EMP_ID AS userId , A.EMP_NM AS userNm , A.DEPT_NM AS deptNm , A.POSITION_NM AS positionNm , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SUB.INPUT_RATE), 0) FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT SUB WHERE TRIM(SUB.EMP_ID) = TRIM(A.EMP_ID) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND SUB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN SUB.START_DT AND SUB.END_DT ) AS currentLoad FROM TB_EMP A WHERE A.IN_OFFICE = 'Y'
AND A.EMP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchNm}, '%')
ORDER BY A.EMP_NM ASC

SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId , P.PROJ_NM AS projNm , A.ASSIGN_TITLE AS title , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate , A.INPUT_RATE AS inputRate FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT A INNER JOIN TB_PROJECT P ON A.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID WHERE A.EMP_ID = #{userId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
